en.headline: EVOKE Festival stages open-air electronic music on Hung Hom harbourfront this Halloween
en.dek: The event runs from 4pm to 10:30pm on 31 October at the New Hung Hom Harbourfront, with an after-party continuing until 4am.
body: EVOKE Festival will take place on 31 October at the New Hung Hom Harbourfront, described by organisers as Hong Kong’s first 270-degree open-air electronic music event overlooking Victoria Harbour.

The main music programme is scheduled from 4pm to 10:30pm, followed by an after-party from 11pm to 4am at Soho House Hong Kong. Tickets are available at various prices through the event’s official channels.

Organised by Social Club Series, the festival features an international DJ lineup and is supported in listings by the Hong Kong Tourism Board. It forms part of the city’s broader Halloween programming along the waterfront.

zh.headline: EVOKE音樂節萬聖節登陸紅磡新海濱 主打戶外電音
zh.dek: 活動於10月31日下午4時至晚上10時30分在紅磡新海濱舉行，之後派對延至凌晨4時。
body: EVOKE音樂節將於10月31日在紅磡新海濱舉行，主辦單位形容為香港首個270度維港景觀戶外電子音樂活動。
主音樂節目由下午4時至晚上10時30分，其後在Soho House Hong Kong舉行由晚上11時至凌晨4時的之後派對。門票價格不一，可透過活動官方渠道購買。
由Social Club Series主辦，並獲香港旅遊發展局活動列表收錄，屬本港萬聖節海濱系列活動之一。
